limitations: Single source seed20262020; Industrial1395/52 and RF100151/35 are previously viewed development domains, not blind tests. No seed SD, significance or universal-generalization claim.

Source coverage, repeated image exposure, new source validation, source scheduler and adaptive duration jointly differ from prior runs. Differences do not identify a single camera-roll causal effect or equal-budget comparison.

New roll512 validation is independent in layouts, IDs, groups and declared generated seeds but shares the available source HDR. Original1506 retains its old scene guard. The new validation has no V16 inference baseline.

This bounded audit uses saved scalar rows and execution metadata only. It loads no model, weights, RGB, features or geometry and performs no forward/backward/update, old GT recomputation, preflight, test suite or target evaluation.

Original-contract preservation is an exact saved metadata comparison on the server; model input and source-only behavior are supported by executed source and saved preflight, not a new runtime reenactment.
RF100 scalar labels are offline derived from four annotated points. Historical GeoPRR comparison retains saved same-population lineage; its executed pixels and full weight chain are not recertified.

Training loss checks cover saved finite aggregates only. No batchloss is reconstructed from validation predictions. Process, full process, pipeline, supervisor, source generation and preflight costs retain separate boundaries.

All incompatible old models, G1/anchor failures, 65-epoch runs and negative results remain separate. Different checkpoints cannot be combined into one best model; there is no automatic promotion or zero-new-wrong veto.
